biotools.summary: consHLA is a software workflow that leverages next-generation sequencing data (WGS and RNA-seq) to perform consensus-based HLA typing, enhancing accuracy and resolution compared to traditional methods. The tool is particularly designed to improve HLA typing for cancer patients by integrating germline and tumor sequencing data.
